name: Eco World Development Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团通过合资平台拓展澳大利亚与Iskandar Malaysia的房地产开发，并以子公司Ecoworld Development (S) Pte Ltd在新加坡中标一幅住宅用地；同时，工业板块的Eco Business Park 8完成收购柔佛Kulai约935.241英亩永久工业用地。商业板块一项位于Semenyih的约22.734英亩商业用地收购因条件期届满而终止。
overview_en: In 2026, the Group expanded property development in Australia and Iskandar Malaysia through joint-venture platforms, and its subsidiary Eco World Development (S) Pte Ltd was awarded a residential land parcel in Singapore. Meanwhile, the industrial segment's Eco Business Park 8 completed the acquisition of approximately 935.241 acres of freehold industrial land in Kulai, Johor.

segments.name: 住宅
segments.note: 今年通过新加坡子公司中标一幅住宅用地，并设立合资平台拓展澳大利亚与Iskandar Malaysia的房地产开发。
segments.note_en: This year, the Group's Singapore subsidiary was awarded a residential land parcel, and joint-venture platforms were established to undertake property development in Australia and Iskandar Malaysia.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Eco World Development (S) Pte Ltd获新加坡市区重建局授予一幅位于Lorong Puntong / Sin Ming Avenue、面积约4,283.4平方米的地块。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Eco World Development (S) Pte Ltd was awarded a land parcel measuring approximately 4,283.4 square metres at Lorong Puntong / Sin Ming Avenue in Singapore by the Urban Redevelopment Authority.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 全资子公司Ascension Synergy Sdn Bhd与JLG Investment Holdings Sdn Bhd相关公司签订3份认购及股东协议，设立各持股50%的合资平台，在澳大利亚和Iskandar Malaysia进行房地产开发。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Ascension Synergy Sdn Bhd entered into three subscription and shareholders' agreements with companies related to JLG Investment Holdings Sdn Bhd to establish 50:50 joint-venture platforms for property development in Australia and Iskand…

segments.note_en: This year, Eco Business Park 8 completed the acquisition of approximately 935.241 acres of freehold industrial land in Kulai, Johor, and progressed related shareholders' agreements and financial assis…

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Eco Business Park 8 Sdn Bhd于2026年6月26日完成收购柔佛Kulai约935.241英亩永久工业用地。
actions.text_en: Eco Business Park 8 Sdn Bhd completed the acquisition of approximately 935.241 acres of freehold industrial land in Kulai, Johor on 26 June 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Eco Business Park 8 Sdn Bhd收购柔佛Kulai约935.241英亩永久工业用地的买卖协议于2026年6月11日成为无条件，修订及重述的股东协议同日生效。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement for Eco Business Park 8 Sdn Bhd's acquisition of approximately 935.241 acres of freehold industrial land in Kulai, Johor became unconditional on 11 June 2026, and the amended and restated shareholders' agreement took effect on t…

segments.name: 商业
segments.note: 今年一项位于Semenyih的约22.734英亩商业用地收购因条件期届满而终止。
segments.note_en: This year, a proposed acquisition of approximately 22.734 acres of commercial land in Semenyih was terminated upon expiry of the conditional period.

actions.text: 81%持股子公司Mutiara Balau Sdn Bhd收购Semenyih约92,000平方米（约22.734英亩）永久商业用地的买卖协议，因条件期届满而双方终止。

segments.note_en: At the group level this year, the Group progressed joint-venture platforms with JLG Investment Holdings and the acquisition of Eco World (Macquarie) Pty Ltd, and extended the sunset date of the relate…

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 合资公司Versione Node Sdn Bhd收购Eco World (Macquarie) Pty Ltd 100%股权的买卖协议，双方书面同意将截止日期延长至2026年12月13日。
actions.text_en: The parties to the sale and purchase agreement for the joint-venture entity Versione Node Sdn Bhd's acquisition of 100% equity interest in Eco World (Macquarie) Pty Ltd mutually agreed in writing to extend the sunset date to 13 December 2026.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 通过Ascension Synergy Sdn Bhd与JLG Investment Holdings相关公司设立各持股50%的合资平台，在澳大利亚和Iskandar Malaysia进行房地产开发。
model_changes.text_en: Through Ascension Synergy Sdn Bhd, the Group established 50:50 joint-venture platforms with companies related to JLG Investment Holdings Sdn Bhd to undertake property development in Australia and Iskandar Malaysia.
